attack_techniques: Remote Services: Direct Cloud VM Connections (T1021.008)
attackers_goals: Maintain persistence on a compromised compute instance. Escalate local privileges to gain root on compute instance.
description: An identity attempted to modify the SSH keys of a single compute instance. This may indicate an attacker's attempt to maintain persistence on the cloud instance.
investigative_actions: Investigate if SSH keys were modified or added at the instance or project level. Investigate which permissions were obtained as a result of the SSH keys modification.
name: Suspicious cloud compute instance SSH keys modification attempt
